/* Fail_master_run_check : Exec_run_check 실패 시. Master 는 PENDING -> FAILED */
UPDATE adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run
   SET status          = 'FAILED',
       child_total_cnt = 0,
       child_succ_cnt  = 0,
       child_fail_cnt  = 0,
       error_log       = left('[Exec_run_check] '
                              || '@{replace(activity('Exec_run_check').error.message, '''', '''''')}', 4000),
       end_dt          = now(),
       updated_by      = '@{pipeline().DataFactory}',
       updated_dt      = now()
 WHERE master_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}'
   AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING');

activities.name: Start_ingest_pipeline Script
activities.description: Master RUNNING 전환 + 수집 이력 PENDING 생성 (재시도 0)

text.value:
/* 4. 수집 이력 PENDING 생성 */
ins AS (
    INSERT INTO adfadm.ctl_ingest_pipeline_run
    (
        master_run_id,
        run_group_id,
        run_rule_id,
        target_id,
        ingest_pipeline_nm,
        run_type_cd,

        sink_type_cd,
        load_method_cd,
        range_column_nm,
        range_operator_cd,
        range_value,

        incr_policy_id,
        incr_column_nm,
        incr_from_val,
        incr_to_val,

        src_type,
        src_db_nm,
        src_schema_nm,
        src_table_nm,

        cdc_tgt_db_nm,
        cdc_tgt_schema_nm,
        data_class,

        extract_query,
        landing_path,
        file_name,

        status,
        created_by
    )

    SELECT
        p.master_run_id,
        t.run_group_id,
        t.run_rule_id,
        t.target_id,
        t.pl_nm,
        'INCR',

        t.sink_type_cd,

        CASE
            WHEN t.sink_type_cd = 'GEN2'
                THEN t.incr_load_method_cd
        END,

        CASE
            WHEN t.sink_type_cd = 'GEN2'
             AND t.incr_load_method_cd = 'RANGE_DELETE_INSERT'
                THEN t.incr_column_nm
        END,

        CASE
            WHEN t.sink_type_cd = 'GEN2'
             AND t.incr_load_method_cd = 'RANGE_DELETE_INSERT'
                THEN '>='
        END,

        CASE
            WHEN t.sink_type_cd = 'GEN2'
             AND t.incr_load_method_cd = 'RANGE_DELETE_INSERT'
                THEN jsonb_build_array(
                    t.range_val
                )
        END,

        t.incr_policy_id,
        t.incr_column_nm,
        t.from_val,
        NULL,

        t.src_type,
        t.src_db_nm,
        t.src_schema_nm,
        t.src_table_nm,

        NULLIF(
            trim(t.cdc_tgt_db_nm),
            ''
        ),

        NULLIF(
            trim(t.cdc_tgt_schema_nm),
            ''
        ),

        t.data_class,

        /* 추출쿼리 */
        CASE
            WHEN NULLIF(
                    trim(t.src_query_template),
                    ''
                 ) IS NOT NULL

                THEN replace(
                    t.src_query_template,
                    '{WHERE}',
                    t.cond_sql
                )

            ELSE
                'SELECT * FROM '
                || t.ext_schema_nm
                || '.'
                || t.src_table_nm

                || CASE
                       WHEN upper(t.src_type) = 'MSSQL'
                           THEN ' WITH (NOLOCK)'
                       ELSE ''
                   END

                || ' WHERE '
                || t.cond_sql

                || CASE
                       WHEN upper(t.src_type) = 'DB2'
                           THEN ' WITH UR'
                       ELSE ''
                   END
        END,

        t.landing_path_out,
        t.file_name_out,

        'PENDING',
        p.created_by

    FROM t
    CROSS JOIN p

    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM mst
    )

    RETURNING
        ingest_pipeline_id,
        master_run_id,
        ingest_pipeline_nm,
        extract_query,
        landing_path,
        file_name,

        target_id,
        src_db_nm,
        src_schema_nm,
        src_table_nm,
        cdc_tgt_db_nm,
        cdc_tgt_schema_nm,

        sink_type_cd,
        load_method_cd,
        incr_column_nm,
        incr_from_val,
        range_value,
        status
)

/* 5. ForEach 입력 */
SELECT
    ingest_pipeline_id,
    master_run_id,
    ingest_pipeline_nm,
    extract_query,

    COALESCE(
        landing_path,
        ''
    ) AS landing_path,

    COALESCE(
        file_name,
        ''
    ) AS file_name,

    target_id,
    src_db_nm,
    src_schema_nm,
    src_table_nm,
    cdc_tgt_db_nm,
    cdc_tgt_schema_nm,

    sink_type_cd,
    load_method_cd,
    incr_column_nm,
    incr_from_val,
    range_value::text AS range_value,
    status

FROM ins

ORDER BY target_id;

activities.name: ForEach_child_ingest
activities.description: 수집 대상별 자식 수집 파이프라인 호출

text.value:
/* End_master_run : ForEach 완료 시 (성공 / 실패 모두). RUNNING 인 Master 만 갱신 (Fail_master_run 이 바꾼 행 · SKIPPED 는 유지)
   종료 시점에 RUNNING / PENDING 으로 남은 수집 행은 실패로 집계 */
WITH c AS (
    SELECT count(*)                                                        AS total_cnt,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'SUCCEEDED')                    AS succ_cnt,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('FAILED','RUNNING','PENDING')) AS fail_cnt
      FROM adfadm.ctl_ingest_pipeline_run
     WHERE master_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}'
       AND status <> 'SKIPPED'
)
UPDATE adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run m
   SET child_total_cnt = c.total_cnt,
       child_succ_cnt  = c.succ_cnt,
       child_fail_cnt  = c.fail_cnt,
       status          = CASE WHEN c.fail_cnt = 0 THEN 'SUCCEEDED' ELSE 'FAILED' END,
       error_log       = CASE WHEN c.fail_cnt = 0 THEN m.error_log
                              ELSE '수집 실패 ' || c.fail_cnt || '건 (ctl_ingest_pipeline_run 확인)' END,
       end_dt          = now(),
       updated_by      = '@{pipeline().DataFactory}',
       updated_dt      = now()
  FROM c
 WHERE m.master_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}'
   AND m.status = 'RUNNING';

/* Fail_master_run : Start_ingest_pipeline Script 실패 시. 수집 이력 INSERT 실패면 같은 문장의 RUNNING 전환도 취소되어 Master 는 PENDING 으로 남아 있음 */
UPDATE adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run
   SET status          = 'FAILED',
       child_total_cnt = 0,
       child_succ_cnt  = 0,
       child_fail_cnt  = 0,
       error_log       = left('[Start_ingest_pipeline Script] '
                              || '@{replace(activity('Start_ingest_pipeline Script').error.message, '''', '''''')}', 4000),
       end_dt          = now(),
       updated_by      = '@{pipeline().DataFactory}',
       updated_dt      = now()
 WHERE master_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}'
   AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING');
